g.text: Invalid generate-plan arguments: preserve the cause and recover
Append GENERATE_PLAN_USAGE if not already present.
The cause is retained for logs, not printed as a console stack trace.
No GeneratePlanCommand is constructed or executed; recipes, plan, targets, and groceries remain unchanged.
This sequence depicts the parser cause-preservation contribution, not ownership of the original command.
Static helpers splitIntoValues and parseDays are shown on the planParser lifeline to keep the view compact.
Valid requests can reach the existing generator, whose added assertions check day count and recipe prerequisites.
Its FINE diagnostics report request sizes, target presence, and matching-candidate counts; those paths are not run here.
GeneratePlanCommand also wraps generation failures with their cause. Related list/delete validation uses the same pattern.
